relationships.subject: spared nerve injury
relationships.evidence_quote: SNI up-regulated HMGB1, TLR4, myeloid differentiation factor-88 adaptor protein (MyD88) and NF-κB p65 protein expression in the DRG.

relationships.subject: electroacupuncture
relationships.evidence_quote: 2 Hz EA stimulation effectively reversed the elevations of HMGB1, TLR4, MyD88 and NF-κB p65 induced by SNI in the DRG

relationships.subject: HMGB1
relationships.evidence_quote: Neuropathic pain can be provoked by high mobility group box 1 (HMGB1) activation of toll-like receptor (TLR)4/nuclear factor (NF)-κB signaling in the dorsal root ganglion (DRG).

key_findings: 2 Hz electroacupuncture reverses SNI-induced HMGB1/TLR4/MyD88/NF-κB elevation in DRG and reduces mechanical hypersensitivity.
TLR4 and MyD88 co-localize with CGRP and IB4 in DRG.
